title: 七十二变练习
subtitle: 本领不是一下子变出来的
origin: 《西游记》第二回（低龄温和改编补遗）

moral.zh: 学习新本领会出错，先从小目标开始、认真复盘，就能一天比一天更稳。
moral.en: New skills come with mistakes. Small goals and thoughtful practice make us steadier day by day.

pages.zh: 祖师让悟空先别急着变大老虎，只从一片松叶开始练。
pages.en: Master Puti told Wukong not to begin with a great tiger, but with one small pine leaf.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[MASTER_PUTI]] In a safe temple clearing, Master Puti holds one pine leaf while Wukong watches closely; no tiger or scary imagery.

pages.zh: 悟空念动口诀，脑袋变成松叶，尾巴却还在后面摇呀摇。
pages.en: Wukong tried the spell. His head became a pine leaf, but his tail still wagged behind him.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] Playful gentle transformation practice: Wukong remains friendly, with a soft pine-leaf-shaped green head silhouette while his familiar tail sticks out; classmates giggle kindly.

pages.zh: 大家没有笑话他，只把看到的地方画成圆点和线，帮他找到遗漏。
pages.en: No one teased him. The students used dots and lines to show what he had missed.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] Temple students arrange pebbles and twigs into a wordless body-and-tail checklist on the ground while Wukong listens with a grin.

pages.zh: 第二次，他变成一只小鸟，翅膀会拍，脚却还是猴脚。
pages.en: The second time he became a little bird, but his feet were still monkey feet.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] A charming partial bird transformation hovers just above a padded grass mat: golden-brown bird body, Wukong's amber eyes and harmless monkey feet; joyful, not uncanny.

pages.zh: 悟空停下来，先摸摸脚趾，再观察树枝上的麻雀怎样收起小脚。
pages.en: Wukong paused, checked his toes, and watched how a sparrow tucked its feet on a branch.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] Wukong in normal monkey form observes a friendly sparrow tucking its feet on a low branch; attentive close study, warm morning.

pages.zh: 第三次，小鸟稳稳落在软垫上，又变回了笑眯眯的悟空。
pages.en: On the third try, the bird landed safely on the mat and changed back into smiling Wukong.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] Soft golden sparkles show a small bird landing on a woven mat and becoming Wukong again; Master Puti and students applaud gently.

pages.zh: 祖师说：“七十二变不是七十二次炫耀，而是七十二次认真观察。”
pages.en: “The seventy-two transformations are not for showing off,” said the Master, “but for seventy-two acts of careful observation.”
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[MASTER_PUTI]] Master Puti gestures toward leaf, bird feather, pinecone and round coin study objects while Wukong sits focused; no readable text.

pages.zh: 悟空把今天的三次尝试记在心里，决定明天再从一片叶子练起。
pages.en: Wukong remembered his three attempts and chose to begin again with a leaf the next day.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] At sunset Wukong places one pine leaf, one feather and three pebbles neatly on a practice mat, smiling at tomorrow's lesson.
